title: API
description: A contract other software calls or subscribes to: a REST/GraphQL/gRPC/WebSocket interface, or a Kafka topic described by an AsyncAPI document. The service that implements it lists it under provides_apis; callers under consumes_apis. Backstage kind: API (type → spec.type, definition_url → spec.definition via $text, system → spec.system, the team field → spec.owner; exposure/hosting_model → labels).

type.title: Type
type.description: The API type dictionary; a Kafka topic is asyncapi.

definition_url.title: Definition
definition_url.description: Where the OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL/proto document lives (Backstage spec.definition: $text).

definition.title: Inline definition
definition.description: The document itself, when it has no home of its own.

external.title: External
external.description: A third party's API we call but do not own (Backstage namespace external).
